numbers.note: Use tabular-nums for tables, totals, and invoices to ensure decimal alignment.

visual enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for hover states.
visual enhancers.radius: rounded-lg for main containers, rounded-md for inputs/buttons.
visual enhancers.print_styles: Use black and white strictly for print mode. -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact.

dashboard.container: w-full min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex flex-col md:flex-row
dashboard.sidebar: w-64 bg-slate-900 text-white min-h-screen hidden md:block

specifics: Create an InvoicePrintComponent that repeats 3 times for Original, Duplicate, and Triplicate.
Add `@media print` rules in global css to force A4 size and hide non-print UI.
Ensure tables in print are border-collapse with solid black borders for clear physical printing.

motion.hover: Subtle background shifts and shadow elevation. No extreme bouncy animations for ERP.
motion.active: Slight scale down (scale-95) for buttons on click.
motion.transitions: Use transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out for interactive elements.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA standards. Use slate-700 or slate-900 for text.
accessibility.forms: All inputs must have associated labels. Use visual cues (red text/borders) for validation errors.

media.breakpoints: Use standard Tailwind md (768px), lg (1024px), xl (1280px) breakpoints.
media.print: Use @media print strictly to isolate print layout. Hide sidebar and navigation.

3d libraries.usage: Not recommended for this dense billing/ERP application. Stick to fast, responsive 2D DOM elements.

billing_invoice_creation: Select Customer from a searchable dropdown.
Dynamic line items: Add row, pick product from Inventory.
Auto-populate SKU, Price, and available stock.
Apply CGST/SGST (e.g., 9% each) and optional flat discount.
Calculate Grand Total. Show Amount in Words.
stock_management: Show a warning badge if Qty added in invoice exceeds available stock.
Highlight low-stock items in the Inventory Table.

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react for all interface icons (Dashboard, Inventory, Users, FileText, Printer, Plus, Trash).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize exact money communication. Use tabular-nums for all currency amounts.
Do NOT center-align the app container. Left-align dense data, right-align numbers/currency.
Never use `transition: all`. Use specific transitions like `transition-colors` or `transition-opacity`.
Include `data-testid` attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, rows) for testing.

For the Print Invoice feature, use `@media print` heavily. Ensure there's an iteration mechanism that renders the exact same invoice UI three times with the labels 'Original for Recipient', 'Duplicate for Transporter', and 'Triplicate for Supplier', with `page-break-after: always` separating them.

Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions like dialogs or select menus, but standard HTML/Tailwind for the dense Invoice line-item tables to maintain fine-grained control over spacing and print layout.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for the header/nav.
Add 'sonner' for toast notifications (e.g., 'Invoice Saved', 'Stock Deducted').
